name: M109A7 Paladin 155 mm self-propelled howitzer (present-day row; js/hero/us_paladin.js HeroPaladin 'e20', the same build as nato_e00_spg 'e00' in another tan)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'M109 howitzer': hull 20.3 ft (6.19 m), width 10 ft 4 in (3.15 m), height 10 ft 8 in (3.25 m, over the hull roof fittings, not the whips), 32 ft (9.75 m) gun forward for the A1-A7 - NOT used as the gated published length: it is not confirmed for the A7 and reference A's tube is drawn too long to settle it (see not_confirmed). The model's X extent is 9.52 m (the bustle rack x -3.82 to the muzzle x 5.70, a 39-calibre M284 taken as 5.25 m trunnion to muzzle); the 2.4% gap to 9.75 is the reference sheet's own tube discrepancy (header) and is left. Width 3.20 m over the turret bins.

engine_contract.rows: HeroPaladin.build(THREE, M, C, which): e60 nato_e60_spg, e80 nato_e80_spg (also deu_us_pattern.js, roc_artillery.js, gb rows), e90 nato_e90_spg (also skirmish_reuse.js spg_r), e00 nato_e00_spg, e20 spg_n. HeroPaladin.variants and .pack are read by other files.
engine_contract.nodes: 'turret' at the ring (x -1.0, z = deck) with 'barrel' on the trunnion inside it; six 'roadwheel' groups (A7); render3d lays the gun

must_show: flat-topped hull 6.16 m long (x -3.08 .. 3.08), deck z 1.80, a tall upright nose plate (x 3.08, z 0.60 .. 1.50) and a short glacis to the deck at x 2.33 [G, H]

SIX road wheels a side (x 1.80 .. -1.70 at 0.70 m pitch, r 0.32, z 0.41), the drive sprocket at the FRONT (x 2.58 z 0.62), the idler at the rear (x -2.50), no return rollers: the top run lies on the wheels [G, H; en.wikipedia]
the wide 0.53 m Bradley track (y +-1.31 centre) with its pads and end connectors on the top run [G, H]
the big box turret over the rear two thirds: walls leaning in, the long sloped face (foot x 0.98, top x 0.55), roof z 2.91, ring at x -1.0 [A, G]
the armoured bustle overhanging the hull tail to x -3.79 (floor z 1.94), a wire rack on its tail and rails down its sides [A, F, H]
the 39-calibre M284 with its cradle cover, bore evacuator half way and the double-baffle brake, the muzzle at x 5.70 z 2.33 [A, G]
the deep Paladin gun-mount housing in the turret face (x 0.62 .. 1.16, y +-0.56) [A]
the commander's cupola at the right rear of the roof (x -1.10, y -0.80) with the M2 on a raised mount [A, G]
the armoured panoramic-sight hood on the left front of the roof (x -0.15 .. 0.32, y 0.62 .. 1.10) [B, D]
stowage bins along both turret sides (x -1.05 .. 0.05 and -2.40 .. -1.55, y +-1.43 .. 1.60) with lids and latches [G, H]
the travel lock folded on the glacis, lamp clusters in their welded brush guards on the nose corners (y +-1.20), black rubber flaps over the nose corners [C, E, G, H]
two whip aerials at the rear corners of the roof (x -3.40, y +-1.15) [A, G]
plain tan paint over hull and turret (seen #d4c090 in sun), no markings, numbers or camouflage; team colour on the front deck (x 1.13 .. 1.63, y 0.25 .. 0.95) and the roof tail (x -3.10 .. -2.70)
